headline: Bitcoin pushed above $84,000 and Solana switched on its biggest upgrade since 2020, with Tesla and Meta earnings due after tonight's US close.

stories.title: Bitcoin breaks above $84,000 and forces out about $188M of bets against it
stories.summary: Bitcoin rose above $84,000 on Wednesday, the top of the range it has traded in for the past week. The move forced many traders who had bet on a fall to close their positions. Price swings are still close to their smallest of 2026 as traders wait for the Fed decision on 28 Oct.
points: Bitcoin briefly came close to $84,739, per Bitcoin.com (published 15:45 UTC, 22:45 Bangkok).
Forced closures (liquidations) over 24 hours totalled $243.04M across 71,223 traders. Bets on a fall made up $188.14M (77.4%); bets on a rise $54.89M.
Bitcoin's 28-day realized volatility is 1.2%, near its lowest of 2026, per K33 data reported by The Block. Bitcoin had traded between $80K and $84K for the past week.
On 19 Oct BlackRock's IBIT took in 8,128 BTC, its biggest daily inflow since April 2025. All US spot Bitcoin ETFs together took in a net 6,436 BTC that day.
Brent oil traded above $110 after attacks near the Strait of Hormuz, per CoinDesk.

sources.label: Bitcoin.com: Bitcoin cracks $84K as shorts get wiped out
The Block: Bitcoin volatility nears 2026 lows

stories.title: Solana's Alpenglow upgrade is live, its biggest overhaul since 2020
stories.summary: Solana switched to a new system, called Alpenglow, for agreeing which transactions are final. It replaces TowerBFT, which Solana has used since it launched in 2020. The goal is to make transactions final in a fraction of a second instead of several seconds.
points: The switch happened at slot 459,653,000. Anza, the developer, puts it at about 14:00 UTC; Cointelegraph, citing the Solana Foundation's dashboard, puts it at about 13:54 UTC.

Anza says time to finality fell from about 12.8 seconds to about 150 milliseconds. CoinDesk's preview put the old figure at about 6 seconds. Cointelegraph reported the dashboard still showed 6.6 seconds at the time it published.
Running a validator should cost about 60% less: about 2 SOL a day in vote fees is replaced by a 0.8 SOL ticket per epoch, per CoinDesk.
CoinDesk counts 659 active validators, with 69% of SOL supply staked.
Anza CEO Brennan Watt called it "the largest, most ambitious blockchain upgrade since 'The Merge.'"

sources.label: CoinDesk: Solana's Alpenglow goes live Wednesday

stories.title: SpaceX and Tesla study a merger that would combine more than 30,000 Bitcoin
stories.summary: On SpaceX's earnings call on Tuesday 20 Oct, Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla have set up special committees to study a merger. Together the two companies hold 30,221 BTC. No terms have been agreed. Tesla reports its own results after today's US close.
points: Holdings: 18,712 BTC at SpaceX and 11,509 BTC at Tesla, 30,221 BTC combined.
Musk: "The special committees have not reached agreement on the terms of any transaction." He added that shareholders would have to support it.
SpaceX Q3 revenue was $14.58B against a $12.7B estimate.
Forecasts for Tesla's results differ: CoinDesk cites $28.13B revenue and 44c adjusted earnings per share; Zacks (via BloFin) has $27.79B and 43c.

sources.label: CoinDesk: SpaceX and Tesla explore merger

briefs.title: Grayscale lets investors pay into 10 crypto funds with tokens
briefs.summary: Eligible investors can now swap tokens such as BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP and DOGE directly for fund shares (in-kind subscriptions).

briefs.title: US bank regulator finalizes a GENIUS Act stablecoin rule
briefs.summary: The OCC set the requirements that stablecoin issuers under its oversight must meet, covering reserves, redemption and custody. The law takes effect on 18 Jan 2027.

briefs.title: Standard Chartered agrees to buy all of Zodia Custody
briefs.summary: The bank signed a deal for 100% of the crypto custody firm. Terms were not disclosed and regulators still have to approve it.

briefs.title: White House event on overseas crypto scams
briefs.summary: The FBI counted over $11B in US crypto-related losses in 2025.

briefs.title: Zcash sets its NU7 upgrade for November
briefs.summary: NU7 cuts block times from 75 to 25 seconds. ZEC was up about 11% over 24 hours in CoinDesk's morning report.

briefs.title: Weak web security keys cracked at eMudhra
briefs.summary: Eight of the Indian certificate company's secret keys were weak enough to crack. Browsers block the affected certificates, but some developer tools did not, so trading bots and wallet back-ends should update.

briefs.title: UK banks drew 10,092 complaints over blocked crypto transfers
briefs.summary: The complaints came between May and August, per a Stand With Crypto report. Lloyds had the most, 2,297.
